brief: c118: the footbridge has an evening nobody reaches — EVE_SPOTS' two deck posts fit 0 times in 30 evenings because the plaza crossing alone is ~4 h from every gate. Give the deck an ALREADY-THERE source: when eveOpen() is true (or will be within the walk) an east arrival (spawnEastAgent, a.east) whose stop is on the far side and who would otherwise retrace at eastOpen()'s close instead STAYS ON — re-routed by the one re-route (callIn is the model) onto a free deck post under eveOpen(), leaving by the retire rule a.dusk && !eveOpen() like the others. Price it: count who is on the far side at sunDown − 2.5 h before choosing the share. Count at the CHOICE.
successLooksLike: probes/evening-arrivals.mjs extended: over 10 seeds × 4 summer days the deck posts are taken on most open evenings (>50%), total evening presence rises without the other posts losing occupancy; winter still 0. Crop at sunDown + 1 h with a figure leaning on the deck rail above the boat.
avoid: Do not widen EVE_LEAD again. Do not add a gate source — the ledger proved the deck cannot be reached from any edge inside the window. Do not steal from eastCap's daylight budget by more than the share you counted.
